newsitem.title: USA: Kohl's August same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Kohl's August same store sales rise.

text.p: Kohl's Corp said Thursday that same store sales for the four weeks ended August 31 increased 8.9 percent.
Same store sales exclude its discontinued electronics business.
Kohl's said sales for the four-week period rose 18.6 percent to $187.5 million from $158.1 million for the period ended August 26, 1995.
For the 30 weeks ended August 31, sales were up 27 percent compared with the year-ago period ended August 26, 1995.
On a comparable store basis, excluding the discontinued electronics business, same store sales for the year-to-date period rose 11 percent.
Kohl's said that, due to a shift in the fiscal accounting calendar, the fiscal month-end dates are one week later this year than last year.
On a calendar basis, matching the period ended August 31, 1996 with the period ended September 2, 1995, total sales increased 18.8 percent for the month and 24.7 percent year-to-date, Kohl's added.
Comparable store sales on this adjusted basis increased 8.1 percent for the month and 9.1 percent year-to-date.
Kohl's said it plans to open seven new stores in September and five additional stores in October.
As of August 31, 1996, Kohl's operated 138 stores, compared with 117 stores a year ago.
